Use case: illustration-story

Asset type: tríptico narrativo de La sed de los forasteros; entrada. Una sola imagen completa, sin paneles.

Relato objetivo: Dos comerciantes forasteros cruzan Utta con panela, se detienen por sed y cansancio, y quedan ligados a formas de piedra. Las imágenes narran la carga y la transformación, y condensan el contraste entre mercancía y agua. No hay una deidad visible, uniformes étnicos ni celebración de daño.

Momento y emoción: La carga no puede darles lo que necesitan.

REALISMO MÁGICO EN LO COTIDIANO: un lugar, objeto o acción del relato adquiere un comportamiento imposible que cambia una relación humana o revela una consecuencia.
Conservar la credibilidad material del mundo y hacer visible una contradicción concreta; decir mágico, místico o añadir brillo no describe una acción.
Distinguir hecho narrado y licencia plástica editorial. La licencia puede alterar luz, tiempo, espacio o materia sin atribuir símbolos o episodios nuevos a la tradición.
La escala y el contraste sirven al relato: no exigir gigantismo, primer plano ni oscuridad uniforme. Cada mito necesita su propio vehículo; no copiar el de otra historia.
ANCLA COTIDIANA: Dos cargas de panela en una pausa del camino.
COMPORTAMIENTO IMPOSIBLE: Los bultos rectangulares proyectan sombras de vasijas redondeadas que no existen físicamente.
EFECTO EN EL RELATO: La mercancía no sustituye al agua que necesitan.
QUIÉN ACTÚA Y QUÉ NO CONTROLA EL HUMANO: Los hombres descansan; nadie controla un poder. La anomalía es traducción visual del relato.
FABRICACIÓN EN PAPEL: Sombras recortadas oscuras unidas a cada bulto, forma de vasija distinta de la carga; suelo y horizonte a distancias reales.
CONTRADICCIÓN QUE DEBE VERSE: ¿Dos comerciantes de un octavo del alto, gorra sin ala circular para el segundo y sombras de vasija unidas sólo a las cargas, con mitad izquierda libre?
FUNCIÓN TEMPORAL: acción presente.
ALCANCE: metáfora editorial, no episodio o símbolo tradicional certificado.

Escena: 16:9 VERY DISTANT elevated landscape photograph of an IMMERSIVE CUT-PAPER WORLD, viewed from inside it. NOT a medium shot of people. Geometric constraint: the TWO adult merchants stand only at x70% and x82%, between y39% and y51%, each head-to-shoe height just ONE EIGHTH of the entire image (about 100 pixels in an 864px-tall image). Their small complete silhouettes, both cargo loads and entire jar-shaped shadows are contained in RIGHT THIRD, x64–96%, y37–66%. Vast EMPTY broad ochre paper ground sheets cover lower 40% and left 55%, reserved for website title. Camera high and far, sky and distant low blue-gray paper hills occupy upper third. Small merchant 1 has wide brim STRAW HAT, tiny dark moustache, ochre shirt, charcoal trousers. Small merchant 2 has a LOW SOFT SAND CAP WITH ONLY A SHORT FRONT VISOR, NO circular brim, blue shirt, dark suspenders, terracotta trousers. Both closed shoes, nearly flat profile faces, no sculpted faces or large figures. Exactly TWO small RECTANGULAR plain tied bundles at their feet, each partially exposing AMBER blocks of panela. Each bundle casts ONE narrow shadow connected DIRECTLY to its base, continuing diagonally behind it and widening at far end into silhouette of a ROUND-BELLIED WATER JAR, narrow neck and one handle. Jar shadows about 1.5 times bundle width; readable against plain ground, separate and fully inside image. The solid objects are ONLY rectangular sugar bundles; NO actual jar exists. Both men's ordinary short shadows faint and distinct from those two impossible cargo shadows, no merged shadow origins. Scene is a quiet pause, no gestures of power. Shadows of absent water containers express what sugar cannot provide. All surfaces broad matte dyed cut-paper sheets with fiber, real air and cast shadows at separated distances, no grainy real sand. No box, base, pedestal, tabletop, border, building, deity, tree, giant sun, water, duplicate object or decorative icon.

Tratamiento: Immersive photographed world made ENTIRELY of matte dyed CUT PAPER. Ground, distant hills and objects are broad physical sheets at different distances with visible air, overlaps, occlusion and cast shadows. No photoreal sand or soil, no painted flat collage. Characters are nearly flat brown SIDE-PROFILE cutouts with tiny eye incision and noses in silhouette, natural adult proportions, no modeled cheeks or glass eyeballs. Clothing uses a few broad folded sheets. Full bleed from inside the world; NO outer cardboard, board, model base, plinth, frame, tabletop or stage edge. Magic changes one material relation; no decorative sparkles, auras or glyphs.

Continuidad: Exactly TWO adult merchants, distinct, never twins. Neither is identified as a specific ethnic group by invented features. Merchant 1: slimmer, short black hair and small moustache, plain wide straw-colored hat, OCHRE long-sleeved collared shirt, CHARCOAL long trousers, plain belt and brown closed shoes. Merchant 2: stockier adult with short curly black hair, plain sand cloth cap with short brim, smoke-BLUE long-sleeved shirt, plain dark suspenders, TERRACOTTA long trousers and dark closed shoes. Faces remain flat profile paper silhouettes with tiny eyes, no caricature. Whole body visible, subordinate to the land. No deity or spirit, no people celebrating, no actual injury or corpse. Transformation is continuous material folding, not mutilation or imprisonment.

Color y luz: Luz lateral seca y mate, sombras inequívocas, ocre y azul humo. Sin resplandor sobrenatural.

Licencia visual editorial: Metáfora material y puesta en escena editorial; no nuevo episodio literal, vestuario fechado ni símbolo ancestral.

Control de lectura: ¿Dos comerciantes de un octavo del alto, gorra sin ala circular para el segundo y sombras de vasija unidas sólo a las cargas, con mitad izquierda libre?

Evitar: Pixar, giant portrait, faceted head, glass eyes, exaggerated racial traits; bare chest, loincloth costume for merchants, feathers, facial paint, ceremonial symbols; deity, witch, tree face, floating spirit, aura, glyphs, sun disc, tropical foliage, agave; violence, corpse, agony, trapped body, torn limbs, petrifying weapon, public humiliation; cardboard base, pedestal, isolated model island, frame, table, studio, real sand.

Símbolo editorial no significa símbolo tradicional certificado: conservar la procedencia y la especificidad del relato. Mantener papel recortado, aire entre planos y sombras físicas, sin marco ni soporte exterior.
TESIS SIMBÓLICA: La riqueza dulce no contiene el agua necesaria.
MOTIVO DOMINANTE: Una panela única con vacío de gota.
OPERACIÓN VISUAL: Sustraer la forma de aquello que la mercancía no puede ofrecer.
RELACIÓN CON EL MITO: Contraste editorial del relato entre panela y agua.
PRUEBA VISUAL DEL SÍMBOLO: Panela reconocible y gota inequívocamente vacía, no líquido ni tercera escena.

Its TOP is ONE broad MATTE OCHRE PAPER SHEET with clearly visible long paper fibers and a few clean knife-cut edges; absolutely NO sugar crystals, granular crust, crumbs, mottled food texture or caramel gloss. Its side thickness consists of FOUR broad offset brown/amber paper layers with actual narrow air gaps and cast shadows. A large DRY TEARDROP-SHAPED HOLE passes through ALL layers, revealing plain indigo background, not water. At the hole's edge, stepped paper strata remain clear and separated with their own small shadows; a few subtly irregular torn fibers, not digitally smooth printed drop. One connected block around the hole, not separate pieces. The missing drop is negative space, not blue fill, logo, engraving or surface drawing. Solid sweet matter represented by paper frames the absence of water. No wrapper, typography, cord, bowl, horizon, people, terrain, extra brick, table edge, plinth, display board, studio or outer support. Grazing side light reveals actual cut edges and volumetric paper layers. Editorial symbolic object, not food photography or product advertisement.

Tratamiento: Symbolic sculptural matte CUT PAPER still life, actual separated strata and shadows, full bleed indigo; no studio backdrop edge or external cardboard support.
